import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

MU = np.array([-4.814403298964276, 7.285021880034833, 89.26898187747192])
VAR = np.array([29.181300009685536, -58.159530033123325, 31.783009863299778])

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    T = float(regime.config.get("T", 1.0))
    mu = float(np.polyval(MU, T))
    var = float(np.polyval(VAR, T))
    sd = float(np.sqrt(max(1e-6, var)))
    y = rng.normal(mu, sd, size=n)
    y = np.clip(y, 0, 100)
    return pd.DataFrame({"unit_id": np.arange(n), "y": y})
